items.html: *Indeed, initially, the upper emanator wanted to create those kings in such a manner that they would include a phase of holiness, but she is judgements and Gevurot, and the yeast and the shells are mixed in them. He created them like that deliberately, so there would be reward and punishment in the world, to punish the wicked, and give a good reward to the righteous, and this is not the place to elaborate in it. However, He created them this way on purpose, to revoke them and put them to death, so that holy sparks would be sorted out from them and rise up, and the shells mixed in them would remain below, as dross of gold and yeast of wine.
